# Effect of age classe, season and their interaction on T50

## Hot T50

### March-May-NB-PIO-old

```{r}
#| label: Create-data-frame-Nov-Jan-March-May-NB-PIO-old

TTHot_wide_NB_PIO_old <- TTHot_wide_plant |>
  filter(age_class %in% c("Newly Burnt", "Pioneer")) |>
  filter(leaf_age %in% c("old")) |>
  filter(metric %in% c("T50"))
```

```{r}
#| label: LM-March-May-old-NB-PIO
#| fig-height: 10

# In March, only leaves from the previous year (2025, classified as "old") were available. Although new leaves had emerged by May ("young"), the analysis was restricted to the 2025 cohort ("old") to ensure physiological comparability between the two sampling months.

# The "Building" and "Mature" age classes were excluded from the analysis. In March, individuals from these cohorts suffered total mortality prior to measurements, preventing any estimation of their T50. Consequently, this study focuses exclusively on the "Newly Burnt" and "Pioneer" classes.


modele_lm_1 <- lm(estimate ~ month * age_class, data = TTHot_wide_NB_PIO_old)
performance::check_model(modele_lm_1)
# type = "II": Adjusts the ANOVA for an unbalanced design (unequal sample sizes due to NAs) by testing each main effect independently of the order of factors.

# white.adjust = "hc3": Applies White's correction (HC3) to account for heteroscedasticity (unstable residual variance in May), ensuring robust p-values for small sample sizes. https://bsapubs.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/epdf/10.1002/ajb2.16464

# Assumption for white.adjust: independance --> ok 

print(Anova(modele_lm_1, type = "II")) #, white.adjust = "hc3" # mois très significatif quand on l'enlève

emmeans(modele_lm_1, ~ month)
pairs(emmeans(modele_lm_1, ~ month))
```

```{r}
#| label: Post-hoc-test-month
library(emmeans)
library(multcomp)

comp_mois <- emmeans(modele_lm_1, specs = pairwise ~ month)
summary(comp_mois$contrasts)

valeurs_mois <- emmeans(modele_lm_1, ~ month)

cld(valeurs_mois, Letters = letters)
```

```{r}
#| label: box-plot-month
#| warning: false
library(patchwork)

posthoc_letters <- data.frame(
  month = c("May", "March"),
  letter = c("a", "b"),
  y_pos = c(51.5, 53) 
)

g1 <- ggplot(TTHot_wide_NB_PIO_old, aes(
  x = month,
  y = estimate
)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.07, color = "grey30") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 1, outlier.shape = NA, color = "grey30", fill = "grey95") + 
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = age_class, shape = age_class),
    width = 0.1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8
  ) + 
  
  geom_text(
    data = posthoc_letters,
    aes(x = month, y = y_pos, label = letter),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "T50 (°C)") + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Newly Burnt" = "#c07df0", "Pioneer" = "#7cb815")) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = month),
    fun.data = function(y) { data.frame(y = 39, label = paste0("n = ", length(y))) },
    geom = "text", color = "grey60", size = 3.2, vjust = 0
  ) +
  theme_light() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


g2 <- ggplot(TTHot_wide_NB_PIO_old, aes(
  x = month,
  y = estimate,
  group = age_class
)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = age_class, shape = age_class),
    size = 2, alpha = 1, position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, seed = 42)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(linetype = age_class), 
    fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "black", linewidth = 0.6            
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month", 
    y = "T50 (°C)", 
    color = "Age Class", 
    shape = "Age Class", 
    linetype = "Age Class"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = month),
    fun.data = function(y) { data.frame(y = 39, label = paste0("n = ", length(y))) },
    geom = "text", color = "grey60", size = 3.2, vjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Newly Burnt" = "#c07df0", "Pioneer" = "#7cb815")) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    linetype = guide_legend()
  ) +
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# 4. Assembly and Display
figure_finale <- g1 + g2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')+
  plot_layout(axes = "collect")
figure_finale


ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/poula/Documents/M2_PAMEQ/Stage M2/Figures/Thermal Tolerance (T50) Evolution by month.png",
  plot = figure_finale,
  width = 18, height = 12, units = "cm", dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    linetype = guide_legend()
  ) +
  
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  )
```

## Hot seasonal figure

```{r}
#| label: create-data-frame
#| warning: false

TTHot_wide_all <- bind_rows(TTHot_wide_old_young, TTHot_wide_NB_PIO_old)
```

```{r}
#| label: figure-seasonal-effect
#| warning: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract means from Model 1 (OLD leaves for March and May)
df_old_means <- emmeans(modele_lm_1, specs = ~ month * age_class) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(age_class %in% c("Newly Burnt", "Pioneer")) |>
  mutate(
    leaf_age = "old",
    x_base = ifelse(month == "March", 1, 2),
    x_offset = ifelse(age_class == "Newly Burnt", -0.10, 0.10),
    leaf_dodge = ifelse(month == "May", -0.03, 0),
    x_final = x_base + x_offset + leaf_dodge
  )

# Extract means from Model 2 (YOUNG leaves for May only)
df_young_means <- emmeans(modele_lm_2, specs = ~ leaf_age * age_class) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  filter(leaf_age == "young" & age_class %in% c("Newly Burnt", "Pioneer")) |>
  mutate(
    month = "May",
    x_base = 2, 
    x_offset = ifelse(age_class == "Newly Burnt", -0.10, 0.10),
    leaf_dodge = 0.03,
    x_final = x_base + x_offset + leaf_dodge
  )

# Combine both mean datasets and force-calculate confidence intervals via SE
df_all_means <- bind_rows(df_old_means, df_young_means) |>
  mutate(
    lower.CL = emmean - (1.96 * SE),
    upper.CL = emmean + (1.96 * SE)
  )

# Filter and manually align raw background data points (Removes NA and unwanted groups)
set.seed(42)
df_filtered_raw <- TTHot_wide_all |> 
  filter(age_class %in% c("Newly Burnt", "Pioneer")) |>
  filter(!is.na(leaf_age)) |>  # Cleans up any NA shapes from the legend
  mutate(
    x_base = ifelse(month == "March", 1, 2),
    x_offset = ifelse(age_class == "Newly Burnt", -0.10, 0.10),
    leaf_dodge = case_when(
      month == "March" ~ 0,
      leaf_age == "old" ~ -0.03,
      leaf_age == "young" ~ 0.03
    ),
    x_final = x_base + x_offset + leaf_dodge + runif(n(), -0.015, 0.015)
  )

ggplot(df_all_means, aes(x = x_final, y = emmean)) +
  
  # Background data points
  geom_point(
    data = df_filtered_raw,
    aes(x = x_final, y = estimate, color = age_class, shape = leaf_age),
    size = 1.8, alpha = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Seasonal trend lines
  geom_line(
    data = df_old_means,
    aes(group = age_class, color = age_class),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Clean black error bars for all 6 points 
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, group = interaction(age_class, leaf_age)),
    color = "black", width = 0.03, linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Large mean foreground points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = age_class, shape = leaf_age),
    size = 3.6, show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  
  # Axes adjustments & scale definitions
  ylim(39, 53) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1.0, 2.075), labels = c("March", "May")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("old" = 16, "young" = 17)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Newly Burnt" = "#c07df0", "Pioneer" = "#7cb815")) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "T50 of FvFm (°C)", color = "Age class", shape = "Leaf age") +
  
  # Layout aesthetics styling
  theme_light() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right", 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 4)), 
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.5, color = "black"))
  )
```
